Apparently part of the HTTP 429 Too Many Requests reason was my fault of scrolling down the UI as fast as I could to see 108 + 332 notifications some 30 seconds before pressing "Clear All", which submitted tons of POST requests to have "seen" the notification, e.g. `https://api.vrchat.cloud/api/1/notifications/not_b1b811d7-29a8-40ea-b239-16fecef63760/see`.

```

2026.02.01 12:47:45 Error      -  [API] [628, 429, Post, -1 

https://api.vrchat.cloud/api/1/notifications/not_b1b811d7-29a8-40ea-b239-16fecef63760/see] Abandoning request, because 

- Too Many Requests

2026.02.01 12:48:14 Error      -  [API] [922, 429, Delete, -1 

https://api.vrchat.cloud/api/1/notifications/not_b1b811d7-29a8-40ea-b239-16fecef63760] Abandoning request, because - 

Too Many Requests

```

Apparently the rate-limit cap may have been set way too low for notifications, or the client is unable to effectively clear more than 50 at a time; only 50 notifications were cleared. GET requests didn't seem to be rate-limited.

At this rate, I am only able to clear 50-70 Other Notifications per hour, which is not ideal (feels too slow).

Full `output_log_2026-02-02_05-32-37.txt` is in [ticket #661183]( https://help.vrchat.com/hc/en-us/requests/661183). Sanitized (partially timestamp redacted) is attached.

Alternative proposal/feature request: [Increase API rate limits for "notification see" and "notification delete"](https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/increase-api-rate-limits-for-notification-see-and-notification-delete)

details:
When "Clear All" is pressed, the client tries to clear all notifications individually instead of a single API end-point request to wipe Other Notifications. This triggers HTTP 429 Too Many Requests rate-limiting and fails to remove some notifications.

1. Acquire 100-500 unread Other Notifications.

2. Open Quick Menu, go to Notifications tab, expand to Main Menu, and click "Other Notifications". (Required, because ["Clear All" doesn't work for Other Notifications](https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/1769-clear-all-doesnt-work-for-other-notifications) in Quick Menu.)

3. (Dunno if needed:) Drag the scroll bar through 100-500 Other Notifications, for tons of POST requests to have "seen" a notification. (I had 332 Other Notifications.)

4. Press "Clear All" in Main Menu.

5. Check the logs for 429 responses ("Abandoning request" / "429: notification see failed")

Expected behavior: All notifications are removed without rate-limiting, or with a single API request.

Actual behavior: Rate-limited as the client tries to delete each notification individually, some notifications can't be cleared due to rate-limiting. The issue is exacerbated by [Moderation Report Closed notifications being duplicated](https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/moderation-report-closed-notifications-are-duplicated).

**Full** `output_log_2026-02-01_09-55-54.txt` and `output_log_2026-02-01_12-27-34.txt` (sensitive) are available privately in [ticket #661183](https://help.vrchat.com/hc/en-us/requests/661183). A sample:
